name: XY-MD02 RS485 temperature/humidity transmitter (SHT20)
manufacturer: Generic (XY-MD02 board; manufacturer not named in the document)
doc_revision: XY-MD02 datasheet/protocol PDF (6 pages, no revision stated; hosted by Grenton knowledge base)
notes: Addresses are protocol (0-based) addresses exactly as printed in the command frames: temperature = FC04 start 0x0001, humidity = FC04 start 0x0002, slave address = FC03/06 register 0x0101, baud = register 0x0102 (written together with 0x0101 via FC16 in the example). address_base=0, no conversion. Temperature is a signed 16-bit value /10 (doc: 0xFF33 = -205 = -20.5 C); humidity /10 (0x222=546 -> 54.6 %RH); humidity signedness not stated, uint16 used. Baud register 0x0102: the doc only shows an example writing 0x2580 (=9600) ('Set Baud Rate to 0x2580 by register 2'); it is therefore modelled as a raw baud number; the list of allowed baud values is NOT documented. Temperature/humidity correction registers are mentioned by the Grenton article but their addresses are NOT given in the PDF, so they are omitted. Defaults: address 1~247 (default 1) from the PDF; 9600 baud, no parity, stop bit 1, address 1 from the Grenton article and the PDF's UART table (8 data bits, 9600, 1 stop, no parity). Whether address/baud changes need a power cycle is not stated.

points.name: Baud Rate
points.note: Raw baud number (example in doc writes 0x2580 = 9600). Other permitted values not documented.
